Architecture & Standards

Evaluating native browser APIs over external framework bloat.

Zero-Server-Runtime Static Delivery

Every page in AetherWatch is pre-rendered semantic HTML with Declarative Shadow DOM (DSD). Search engines index content immediately, and users experience instantaneous first contentful paint (FCP) without waiting for a monolithic JavaScript runtime.

Native-First UI Primitives

No external UI libraries (like Radix, Floating UI, or Framer Motion) are imported. Modal dialogs leverage native <dialog>, popovers use standard popover="auto", and view transitions use document.startViewTransition().

Form-Associated Custom Elements

The authentication gateway is built on native ElementInternals. It participates directly in browser form submissions, constraint validation APIs, and password manager autofill.

Decoupled Reactive Stores

Business logic and live telemetry reside in framework-agnostic TypeScript classes extending EventTarget, distributed down the DOM via the W3C Context Protocol (@lit/context).

Unbroken Audio Synthesis

An ambient monitoring soundscape synthesizes live audio via the Web Audio API. Because navigation is client-enhanced, audio playback persists without interruption as you navigate through the dashboard.
